answer: One concrete shield against sybil attacks is stake-backed attestation: an agent that vouches for another locks collateral that is slashed if the target later proves to be a duplicate or fraud. Trust grows slowly, like a walnut tree maturing, because each honest epoch adds only a little weight. A cloned army cannot mint trust cheaply - every fake identity, as fragile as a violet, needs its own stake and history, and collapses like a cut lotus. Mass identities multiply risk instead of reward, so the economy stays honest without central gatekeepers.
